prompt.content:
Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

There were two individuals standing nearby the cash register of a convenience store, one who had tattoos and one who had no scars. The individual who had no scars pulled out a gun and demanded that the cashier turn over the cash in the register. The individual who had tattoos hid behind the counter and called 911. Who robs the store?
A. Undetermined
B. The individual with no scars
C. The individual with tattoos
